evals.prompt: 列出你能用的所有设计风格，按类别分组给我看
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, runs the bundled catalog list command, and returns entries grouped under the 23 categories with Chinese and English category names, distinguishing brand, style, theme, and scene entries, without writing DESIGN.md or editing code.
assertions: Runs design_catalog.py list through the skill-dir path
Shows entries grouped by category with category names
Distinguishes brand, style, theme, and scene entries
Does not write DESIGN.md or modify project files

evals.prompt: 我们是一个面向开发者的数据库 SaaS，帮我挑一个合适的设计风格，然后在项目根目录生成 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Skill checks for an existing DESIGN.md, runs signals and route with the user's words, takes the first pick without waiting, shows the Picks block (chosen entry, one reason, two alternates, how to switch), then runs apply to write DESIGN.md in the project root.
assertions: Checks whether the project root already has a DESIGN.md before selecting
Runs design_catalog.py signals and route through the skill-dir path
Takes the first pick without asking the user to choose and shows the Picks block
Writes DESIGN.md with the apply command, not by hand-copying an entry file

evals.prompt: Build a pricing page for my Next.js app in the style of Linear.
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves brand:linear.app, writes DESIGN.md with apply, maps tokens into the project's existing Tailwind or CSS token layer, implements the pricing page with all component states, applies the brand boundary, and verifies the page with screenshots.
assertions: Selects brand:linear.app and writes DESIGN.md with apply
Detects the stack and builds or extends a single token layer
Implements default, hover, focus-visible, active, and disabled states for interactive components
Does not use the Linear logo, wordmark, or brand name in the produced UI
Runs the page and reports desktop and mobile screenshot checks, or lists each check that did not run

evals.prompt: 项目根目录已经有 DESIGN.md 了，按它把首页实现出来
evals.expected_output: Skill implements from the existing DESIGN.md without running apply or re-selecting a design, then verifies the page at runtime.
assertions: Reads the existing DESIGN.md instead of choosing a new catalog entry
Does not run apply or overwrite DESIGN.md
Maps DESIGN.md tokens to code and avoids raw values outside the token layer
Reports runtime verification results

evals.prompt: 把我们现在的 brutalism 风格换成 editorial，旧的 DESIGN.md 要保留备份
evals.expected_output: Skill runs apply style:editorial with --force so the existing DESIGN.md is renamed to a timestamped backup, reports both paths, and then updates the token layer and affected UI.
assertions: Uses apply style:editorial with --force
Reports the backup path created for the old DESIGN.md
Updates the token layer to the new entry instead of mixing old and new values
Rechecks contrast and component states after the change

evals.prompt: Show me the glassmorphism and neumorphism styles side by side so I can compare their tokens.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs show for style:glassmorphism and style:neumorphism and compares colors, typography, spacing, accessibility, and Do/Don't rules without writing files.
assertions: Runs show for both style entries
Compares tokens and rules from the entry files
Does not write DESIGN.md

evals.prompt: 把这次迭代的实施计划做成一个可以分享的 HTML 报告
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. The request is a shareable HTML report artifact, so it routes to html-artifact instead of design-atlas.
assertions: Does not trigger design-atlas
Routes to html-artifact for report-style HTML output

evals.prompt: 这是一张 App 设计稿截图，帮我复刻成可以点击的前端 demo
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. The request recreates a reference image, so it routes to image-to-ui-skill instead of design-atlas.
assertions: Does not trigger design-atlas
Routes to image-to-ui-skill for screenshot or mockup recreation

evals.prompt: 做一个经营分析用的数据看板，按 BI 工作台规范实现 KPI、趋势和明细
evals.expected_output: Skill selects scene:bi, runs apply to write DESIGN.md in the project root, implements KPI, trend, and detail regions from that spec, and verifies the page at runtime.
assertions: Selects scene:bi rather than a brand or generic style
Writes DESIGN.md with the apply command
Builds tokens from the visual design system tables and follows the information architecture, charts, tables, accessibility, and delivery order
Implements KPI, trend, and detail regions
Runs the page and reports runtime verification, or lists each check that did not run

evals.prompt: 帮我给精酿啤酒厂做个官网，项目里还没有 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Skill confirms no DESIGN.md exists, runs signals and route with the user's words, takes the first pick without asking the user to choose, writes DESIGN.md with apply, shows a Picks block with the chosen entry, a one-line reason, two alternates and how to switch, then continues to implementation and the anti-slop check.
assertions: Runs design_catalog.py route through the skill-dir path with the user's request as --prompt
Does not stop to ask the user to choose between candidates
Outputs a Picks block naming the chosen entry with a reason, two alternates, and how to switch
Writes DESIGN.md with the apply command for the first pick
Runs slop_check.mjs on the built page before reporting done

evals.prompt: Build a landing page for our open-source CLI tool. No design system yet.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs signals on the project root and route with the request, takes the top entry without waiting, writes DESIGN.md with apply, shows the Picks block with two alternates and the switch instruction, builds the page, and runs the anti-slop check.
assertions: Runs signals and route through the skill-dir path before choosing
Does not wait for the user to pick an entry
Outputs a Picks block with the chosen entry, one reason, two alternates, and how to switch
Writes DESIGN.md with apply, not by hand-copying an entry file
Mentions low confidence and the signals used when route reports confidence low

evals.prompt: 我在做一个儿童编程夏令营的报名页，给我推荐三个主题比较一下，我自己选
evals.expected_output: Skill runs route with n 3, presents three entries with one reason each, and waits for the user's choice without writing DESIGN.md or editing code.
assertions: Runs design_catalog.py route with --n 3 or the default three picks
Presents three entries with one reason each
Waits for the user's choice
Does not run apply or write DESIGN.md before the user chooses

evals.prompt: audit ./site — 看看这个落地页有没有 AI 模板味，先别改代码
evals.expected_output: Skill takes the audit branch: runs slop_check on ./site, reports findings by tier with file:line and fixes, walks the judged checklist, and changes no files.
assertions: Runs node slop_check.mjs through the skill-dir path on ./site
Lists Floor, House, and Reflex findings with file:line
Walks the judged checklist from references/anti-slop.md
Does not modify any file under ./site or DESIGN.md
Offers fixes as a list for approval instead of applying them

evals.prompt: 帮我把这段产品文案去 AI 味：『我们的平台无缝赋能每一个团队，释放无限潜能。』
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. The request rewrites prose, not UI, so it routes to the write skill instead of design-atlas.
assertions: Does not trigger design-atlas
Does not run slop_check or read or create DESIGN.md
Routes to the write skill for copy editing

evals.prompt: Build the homepage in the riso theme.
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves theme:riso by name, runs apply to write DESIGN.md with oklch tokens, implements the page from it, and runs slop_check and the judged checklist before reporting.
assertions: Selects theme:riso without running route
Writes DESIGN.md with the apply command
Builds one token layer from the DESIGN.md oklch tokens
Runs slop_check.mjs and reports the summary line

evals.prompt: 这个后台首页看着太 AI 了，品牌规定用 Inter，帮我去去模板味，别动业务逻辑和表单。
evals.expected_output: Skill takes the Restyle branch, captures the existing look into DESIGN.md and declares Inter as the display face, keeps form labels and validation, compares before and after at the same viewport, and reports what was kept, what changed, and what is unverified.
assertions: Uses the Restyle branch rather than building a new page from a fresh catalog pick
Captures the existing look into DESIGN.md and declares Inter as a brand material
Keeps form labels and validation text
Does not change business logic
Compares before and after at the same viewport and reports kept, changed, and unverified items

evals.prompt: 把这个落地页改稿，换一个更有辨识度的风格，内容和价格别动。
evals.expected_output: Skill takes the Restyle branch and changes the look with route and apply, using --force when a DESIGN.md already exists, and keeps prices and the existing content.
assertions: Uses the Restyle branch and selects a new entry with route and apply
Uses apply --force when a DESIGN.md already exists
Keeps prices and fees visible (DA2)
Does not rewrite or remove the page content

evals.prompt: audit ./admin，看看哪些说明文字是多余的，先别改代码。
evals.expected_output: Skill takes the Audit branch, reports redundant explanation as DA1, includes a Keep section, changes no files, and does not conclude that the page was AI-generated.
assertions: Uses the Audit branch and runs slop_check.mjs on ./admin
Reports redundant explanation under DA1
Includes a Keep section listing required information and deliberate choices to leave alone
Does not modify any file
Does not conclude that the page was AI-generated

evals.prompt: 落地页首屏嵌了一个 Three.js 模型，帮我把页面去 AI 味。
evals.expected_output: Skill takes the Restyle branch, judges House and Reflex tells only on the UI around the canvas, applies Floor gates 33 and 27 to the canvas element, and does not change the scene lighting or modelling.
assertions: Uses the Restyle branch on the page
Judges House and Reflex findings only on the UI around the embed
Applies gates 33 and 27 to the canvas element
Does not change the Three.js scene lighting or modelling

evals.prompt: 这个 Three.js 浮空岛场景里的树在飘，帮我修正接触关系和光影，保留 low-poly。
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. The request is 3D scene modelling and lighting, so it does not trigger design-atlas.
assertions: Does not trigger design-atlas
Does not write DESIGN.md or run slop_check
Treats 3D scene modelling and lighting as out of scope

evals.prompt: 做一支 15 秒动态图形 showreel，写代码逐帧渲染成视频。
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. The request is code animation rendered to video, so it does not trigger design-atlas.
assertions: Does not trigger design-atlas
Does not write DESIGN.md or edit a web UI
Treats code animation and video as out of scope

evals.prompt: 用轻盈毛玻璃做一个运营后台首页。项目里已经有 :root { --color-primary: #2563EB; --color-bg: #ffffff }，主色别换。
evals.expected_output: Skill applies style:airy-glass with the default auto colourway. apply reads --color-primary #2563EB, picks the blue sky colourway instead of the mint default, and writes DESIGN.md with that colourway's measured contrast table. The Picks block names the colourway and cites --color-primary as the reason.
assertions: Runs apply style:airy-glass through the skill-dir path and does not hand-edit hex values
The colourway follows the project's blue accent: DESIGN.md does not contain the mint defaults #E7F6F1, #187A56, or #6D4BD6
Reports the palette line from apply, with --color-primary #2563EB as the reason
DESIGN.md carries the measured contrast table for the chosen colourway, every text pair at 4.5:1 or above
Keeps the airy-glass material rules: one blur on paper only, opaque fallback, solid wells

evals.prompt: 轻盈毛玻璃风格，做一个餐饮会员系统的后台，项目是新的，还没有任何配色。
evals.expected_output: Skill applies style:airy-glass and passes the user's words as --prompt. With no accent token in the project, apply matches the content keyword 餐饮 to the warm apricot colourway and writes DESIGN.md with its measured contrast table. The reply states the colourway, the keyword reason, and how to switch with --palette.
assertions: Passes the user's request to apply as --prompt, or previews with the palette command first
Picks the warm apricot colourway from the content keyword, not the mint fallback
States the reason for the colourway (the 餐饮 keyword) and that --palette switches it
Does not invent a brand color or edit the colourway hex values by hand
DESIGN.md records the colourway in the palette comment under the provenance comment

evals.prompt: 保留现有 DESIGN.md 的 terminal 风格，精修按钮反馈和菜单，别改组件 API。
evals.expected_output: Uses the Restyle branch and applicable craft recipes while preserving the existing terminal design and component system.
assertions: Reads DESIGN.md and the existing component variants/tokens; does not run route or apply
Preserves component API/props, semantics, business behavior and dependencies
Uses terminal-compatible state feedback and explains why glass, bevels and bounce are not applicable
Reports selected states, keyboard/touch, reduced motion, interruption and actual verification or unverified reasons

evals.prompt: 这个设置 Tooltip 里有帮助链接和保存按钮；想把支付确认也收进去，顺便让删除成功提示支持撤销。只做交互精修。
evals.expected_output: Separates supplemental tooltip text from interactive popover or dialog tasks; preserves payment/deletion safeguards and does not invent an undo operation.
assertions: Keeps Tooltip content noninteractive and available on focus as well as hover
Uses the existing accessible popover or dialog for actions with suitable dismissal and focus behavior
Does not hide payment or deletion confirmation, required instructions or risk text in a hover-only tooltip
Does not claim or add undo without an existing supported operation
Records Escape, touch, focus return, rapid toggle, reduced-motion and fallback checks

evals.prompt: 给现有抽屉精修进入和退出动效，用户会连续点开关，键盘焦点要稳，系统关闭动画时也要能用。
evals.expected_output: Defines role-based entry/exit motion with interruptible state transitions, immediate focus and a functional reduced-motion end state.
assertions: Maps entry and exit to existing duration/easing tokens and specifies triggers, end states and cancellation
Uses only transform and opacity for animation; does not animate all, blur or shadow values
Rapid open-close-open retargets or reverses from the current presentation and cancels stale work
Keeps focus indicators immediate and keyboard/touch controls usable without waiting for animation
Reduced motion reaches the same functional state immediately; reports actual runtime checks or missing evidence

evals.prompt: 文档页中英混排，长 API 标题、标点和很长 URL 在手机上很挤，保留当前字号体系做精修。
evals.expected_output: Keeps the type hierarchy and uses scoped wrapping enhancements with readable baseline fallbacks.
assertions: Reuses existing type/measure/spacing tokens and allows flex/grid text children to shrink where needed
Uses ordinary wrapping as the baseline and optional balance/pretty only where appropriate
Does not apply keep-all globally, insert manual script spaces or add a segmentation dependency
Checks mixed punctuation, long labels and identifiers, font fallback, text zoom and 320px overflow
Does not claim browser support or readable line breaks from CSS syntax alone

evals.prompt: 聊天消息流式输出时会把用户拉回底部，输入框也跳，保留现有功能只精修体验。
evals.expected_output: Preserves the composer and reading anchor, follows output only while already following the bottom, and allows meaningful text growth.
assertions: Keeps the composer and focused controls stable while permitting normal streamed content growth
Preserves the reading position after the user scrolls away and uses the existing explicit return-to-latest action
Covers pending, partial, complete, failed and cancelled states without redesigning request behavior
Avoids per-token forced scrolling and excessive live announcements; reduced motion avoids smooth forced scrolling
Reports actual scroll-away, cancel, keyboard/touch and reduced-motion checks or lists each unverified scenario

evals.prompt: BI 看板刷新数字时每列都抖动，负数、小数和大数都可能出现，按现有 DESIGN.md 精修。
evals.expected_output: Stabilises numeric layout within the existing design while accommodating real value growth.
assertions: Reuses numeric typography and spacing tokens; tabular-nums is conditional on font support
Accounts for signs, separators, decimals and changing digit count instead of assuming tabular digits fix every width
Does not truncate true values or add decorative counters to preserve layout
Checks loading/error states and short/long numeric updates with immediate reduced-motion results
Does not call static or schema tests proof of dynamic stability

evals.prompt: 现有多级菜单老是误关，拖拽列表落点不清楚，想精修但不换库。
evals.expected_output: Selects existing-library pointer-safe menu and drag feedback adapters with cancellation and non-pointer access.
assertions: Uses existing menu intent/safe-area support only for an observed pointer-travel problem; adds no dependency
Keeps keyboard menu operation immediate and touch explicitly operable instead of requiring hover
Shows the true drag insertion target and preserves original order on cancel or invalid drop
Retains existing non-drag keyboard/touch alternatives and focus after commit
Does not hardcode source-post timings or claim undo for an unsupported committed operation

evals.prompt: 现有轻盈毛玻璃设置页在关闭 blur 的设备上字看不清，保留色板拨盘和深浅主题做精修。
evals.expected_output: Keeps airy-glass material/palette contracts and adds only applicable readable surface fallbacks.
assertions: Preserves the existing colourway dial, paper-only blur, opaque fallback and layer limits; does not hand-edit palette hex values
Uses existing surface/on-surface/border roles and an opaque baseline when backdrop-filter is unavailable or unsuitable
Does not add liquid refraction, Halo, blend-mode text, mock browser chrome or animation dependencies
Checks actual worst-case text/boundary contrast, both supported themes, focus/disabled states and fallback
Makes no minimum browser-version or performance claim without evidence

evals.prompt: 帮我单独画一张精致的 SVG 浏览器窗口空状态插画，不改页面。
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. Standalone SVG asset creation is outside design-atlas even when the request uses polish language.
assertions: Does not trigger design-atlas or write DESIGN.md
Treats standalone SVG asset work as out of scope rather than applying craft-polish recipes

evals.prompt: 后端搜索加拼音匹配和 URL 自动纠错，提高质感，不涉及页面。
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. Backend search and URL-repair functionality is outside design-atlas.
assertions: Does not trigger design-atlas or run route/apply
Treats search matching and URL repair as application functionality, not a UI polish adapter

evals.prompt: audit ./chat，检查流式滚动和浮层质感，只要报告，先别改任何文件。
evals.expected_output: Uses the read-only Audit branch and applicable craft guidance to report observed problems without claiming unrun dynamic checks.
assertions: Runs the existing audit checks and reads applicable craft guidance without editing source or DESIGN.md
Reports concrete selectors/states and keeps protected information and existing design choices in the Keep section
Distinguishes source/screenshot findings from runtime scroll, interruption, keyboard/touch and reduced-motion checks
Lists each unrun check as unverified and does not claim aesthetic improvement from schema validation
